sermons.title: Sermon 461 | Am I Clear Of His Blood?

scripture.verse: "The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the ground."
"Ah Lord God, behold, You have made the Heaven and the earth by Your great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for You."

sermons.title: Sermon 463 | Christ's Servant—His Duty And Reward

scripture.verse: "If any man serve Me, let him follow Me. And where I am, there shall also My servant be: if any man serve Me, him will My Father honor."

"Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not. And let fall also some of the handfuls on purpose for her and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not."

sermons.title: Sermon 465 | The Holy Spirit Glorifying Christ

scripture.verse: "He shall glorify Me: for He shall take of Mine, and shall show it unto you."
"Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves."

"So foolish was I and ignorant: I was as a beast before You. Nevertheless I am continually with You: You have held me by my right hand. You shall guide me with Your counsel and afterward receive me to glory. Whom ha ve I in Hea ven but You? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides You."

"None eye pitied you, to do any of these unto you, to ha ve compassion upon you. But you were cast out into the open field to the loathing of your person, in the day that you were born. And when I passed by you and saw you polluted in your own blood, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live; yes, I said unto you when you were in your blood, Live."
